defs.def: a small insect that lives in highly organized groups. There are many types of ant. 蚂蚁

ex.s: I am, in part, an ant biologist, so my thoughts turned to what we know about insect life and I knew that much in the world of insects remains unknown.
ex.t: 我在一定程度上是一名蚂蚁生物学家，所以我的思绪转到我们对昆虫生命的了解上，我知道昆虫世界中仍有大量未知的事物。

ex.s: Another case study was the fire-ant programme that killed cows, but not fire ants.
ex.t: 另一个案例研究是杀死奶牛但不杀死火蚁的火蚁计划。

ex.s: Murray and his assistants worked hard, but after five years they had only reached the word ant!
ex.t: 默里和他的助手们努力工作，但五年后，他们只达到了“蚂蚁”这个词！

ex.s: Shackleton’s goal was to become the first person to cross the frozen continent of Antarctica.
ex.t: 沙克尔顿的目标是成为第一个穿越南极洲冰冻大陆的人。

ex.s: Early in 1915, with land of Antarctica in sight, the Endurance became trapped in the ice.
ex.t: 1915年初，随着南极洲陆地的出现，耐力号被困在冰中。

ex.s: He might have failed in his goal to cross Antarctica, but he had ensured that everyone on board the Endurance survived.
ex.t: 他可能没有实现穿越南极洲的目标，但他确保了耐力号上的每个人都能幸存下来。

ex.s: Antarctica: the Last Continent Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth.
ex.t: 南极洲：最后的大陆南极洲是地球上最冷的地方。

ex.s: With very little rainfall, Antarctica is technically a desert.
ex.t: 南极洲降雨量很少，从技术上讲是一片沙漠。
